balance.title: Balance Sheet
balance.rangeMeaning: Two instants, not a period: the sheet is as of {{to}}, compared with {{from}}. Nothing on this page is summed over the window.
balance.mockNotice: A design mock — every figure on this page is typed into a fixture file. Nothing here reads from a service.
balance.checkEquityCaption: What is left over — the owner's share
balance.ties: The sheet ties — assets equal liabilities plus equity.
balance.doesNotTie: This sheet does not tie. Assets are out by {{amount}} against liabilities plus equity — the difference is stated here rather than absorbed into a line.
balance.gapSummary: {{untracked}} of {{total}} lines have no source in this system. {{amount}} of the {{position}} position would be typed in by hand.
balance.profitTies: Profit for the period, {{amount}}, matches the Profit screen — the one figure that joins the two reports.
balance.profitMismatch: Profit for the period is {{sheet}} here and {{statement}} on the Profit screen. One of the two reports is wrong.
balance.equityNote: Equity is a residual: {{amount}} is what remains after debts, not money available to spend.

expenses.title: Expenses
expenses.selectTeam: Select a team to view its expenses.
expenses.dateHelp: The date the expense belongs to — payroll paid on the 5th is last month's expense.

voidDialog.title: Void Expense Record
voidDialog.message: This expense will stop counting toward the totals. It stays on the list so the retraction is visible.

opname.title: Stock Opname
opname.selectTeam: Select a warehouse team to count its shelves.
opname.pickShelfTitle: Pick the shelf you are standing at
opname.pickShelfBody: A stock opname counts one shelf at a time. Choose it above and the products on it appear, with what the system believes is there.
opname.unplacedUnsupported: The unplaced pile cannot be counted here yet — it has no shelf to read from. Count a rack instead.
opname.truncated: This shelf holds more products than fit on one screen, so this count cannot cover all of it. Anything you do not count is left untouched.
opname.emptyShelf: The system believes this shelf is empty. Nothing to count.
opname.notePlaceholder: What is this count for? (monthly count, after the leak…)
opname.confirmBody: This corrects real stock and writes off the value of anything missing. {{counted}} counted, {{variances}} differ from the system, {{uncounted}} left uncounted and untouched.
opname.resultLossPartial: At least {{amount}} of stock was written off — some of it came off a batch whose cost was never recorded, so the real figure is higher.

orderSettlement.initialTotalWarning: ⚠ This rewrites the sale every loss on this order is measured against. It cannot be edited or deleted afterwards — only offset.
orderSettlement.reverseBody: This posts a new entry of {{amount}} in the opposite direction. The original stays on the ledger — entries are never edited or deleted.
orderSettlement.appendOnlyNotice: Entries cannot be edited or deleted. A correction is posted as a further entry, so the ledger stays a record of what happened.
orderSettlement.noEstimateTitle: No marketplace total was recorded for this order
orderSettlement.noEstimateBody: Every figure here measures what reached us against what the buyer paid. Without that figure there is nothing to measure against — an order taken by phone has no marketplace total.
orderSettlement.listSubtitle: Orders ranked by how much of what the buyer paid never reached us. A gap is normal — the platform keeps costs it never itemises.
orderSettlement.rowNoEstimate: No marketplace total recorded — nothing to measure against
orderSettlement.addDialogWarning: Entries cannot be edited or deleted afterwards. A mistake is corrected by posting a reversal.
orderSettlement.previewIn: This will add {{amount}} to the order.
orderSettlement.previewOut: This will take {{amount}} from the order.
orderSettlement.occurredHelp: The day the charge belongs to, not today. The day it was recorded is stamped separately.

terms.title: Credit Terms
terms.intro: What you charge each team, and how far you let them run. A balance is never due — the limit is the only control, so lowering it is also the only way to ask for money.
terms.defaultRowHelp: Applies to every team without terms of their own
terms.limitHelp: Unlimited and Frozen are opposites, not degrees. Frozen refuses the next order whatever the balance.
terms.handlingFeeHelp: Flat, per order. Nothing set means you charge nothing.
terms.markupHelp: Percent over the goods' cost when another team sells your product.
terms.reasonRequired: Required — you are changing another team's terms.
terms.reasonOptional: Optional. Recorded in the change log either way.

removeDialog.title: Remove Terms for {{name}}
removeDialog.message: This RAISES their limit to unlimited — it is the only way to express 'no limit' once one is set. Their handling fee and markup fall back to your default row.

terms.empty: No terms set. Every team you trade with is unlimited and charged nothing.
terms.tileNearHelp: At 80% or more of what you allowed
